cues.en: So we've made a Python package with lots of useful functions for evaluating recommender systems.
cues.zh: 我們已經建立 Python 套件，包含許多評估推薦系統的實用函數。

cues.en: Let's see them in action, using a real recommender system trained with real movie ratings from the MovieLens data set.
cues.zh: 接著，使用以 MovieLens 真實電影評分訓練的推薦系統，看看這些函數如何運作。

cues.en: Again, we are using the evaluating folder in our course materials for this section.
cues.zh: 再次提醒，這一節使用課程教材中的 Evaluating 資料夾。

cues.en: Let's open up Test Metrics and MovieLens.py.
cues.zh: 開啟 TestMetrics.py 與 MovieLens.py。

cues.en: We'll start off in Test Metrics by importing the modules we need, including our MovieLens module.
cues.zh: 從 TestMetrics 開始，先匯入需要的模組，包括 MovieLens 模組。

cues.en: Take a quick look at MovieLens.py and see what it does and how it works.
cues.zh: 快速看看 MovieLens.py 做了什麼，以及如何運作。

cues.en: It's responsible for loading up the raw MovieLens files that contain ratings and information about the movies, and converting them into data sets that Surprise can use.
cues.zh: 它負責載入原始 MovieLens 檔案，裡面包含評分與電影資訊，再轉成 Surprise 能使用的資料集。

cues.en: It also includes some useful functions for quickly looking up movie titles, and other utility functions that we'll use later.
cues.zh: 它也包含快速查詢電影名稱的實用函數，以及稍後會使用的其他輔助函數。

cues.en: Okay, so what we're going to do is create a recommender system around the SVD algorithm, and evaluate it across the many metrics we've designed.
cues.zh: 好，我們要以 SVD 演算法建立推薦系統，利用設計的多種指標評估它。

cues.en: How SVD works isn't important right now.
cues.zh: 目前不必在意 SVD 如何運作。

cues.en: We're just seeing if our metrics work.
cues.zh: 只是要確認指標是否有效。

cues.en: We start by loading up the MovieLens data as we saw before and the popularity ranks so that we can later compute novelty.
cues.zh: 先像前面一樣載入 MovieLens 資料，以及熱門排名，以便稍後計算新穎性。

cues.en: This next block builds up the item-to-item similarity scores that we need to compute to diversity.
cues.zh: 下一個區塊建立計算多樣性所需的項目間相似度分數。

cues.en: It turns out that SVD does not compute this as part of what it does, so to cheat, we're going to train a different kind of recommender called KNN that does compute item similarity scores for you.
cues.zh: SVD 本身不會計算這些分數，所以我們取巧一下，另外訓練一種叫做 KNN 的推薦系統，它會替你計算項目相似度。

cues.en: We get the complete data set from MovieLens, set a few parameters on how those similarity scores will be computed, and fit a KNN Baseline recommender in Surpriselib to our MovieLens data set.
cues.zh: 從 MovieLens 取得完整資料集，設定幾個計算相似度分數的參數，再把 SurpriseLib 的 KNNBaseline 推薦系統擬合到 MovieLens 資料集。

cues.en: The resulting algorithm can later be used to retrieve that 2x2 matrix of item similarity scores.
cues.zh: 之後，就能利用產生的演算法，取得那個 2×2 的項目相似度矩陣。

cues.en: Just to keep our run-times reasonable, we're not going to do a full-blown K-fold cross validation; we'll just do a single train/test split.
cues.zh: 為了讓執行時間合理，不做完整的 k 折交叉驗證，只做一次訓練／測試分割。

cues.en: In our example, we will randomly set aside 25% of our data for testing, and use the remaining 75% to train our SVD recommender with.
cues.zh: 這個例子會隨機保留 25% 資料供測試，剩下 75% 用來訓練 SVD 推薦系統。

cues.en: And we do just that; create a new SVD recommender algorithm with a fixed random seed so we get consistent results, and then train the algorithm using the fit function here.
cues.zh: 接著就這樣做：建立新的 SVD 推薦演算法，固定隨機種子以取得一致結果，再使用這裡的 fit 函數訓練。

cues.en: We then process our test set on this algorithm, which gives us back a set of rating predictions for all of the test ratings that it was fed.
cues.zh: 接著讓演算法處理測試集，得到傳入的所有測試評分所對應的評分預測。

cues.en: Now our job is to measure how good those predictions are.
cues.zh: 現在的工作是衡量這些預測有多好。

cues.en: We'll start by using the RMSE and MAE functions in our Recommender Metrics package to measure prediction accuracy.
cues.zh: 先使用 RecommenderMetrics 套件中的 RMSE 與 MAE 函數，衡量預測準確程度。

cues.en: Then we'll turn our attention to top-N recommendations instead.
cues.zh: 接著，把注意力轉到 Top-N 推薦。

cues.en: Remember, top-N recommendations need to be tested differently with Leave One Out Cross Validation.
cues.zh: 記得，Top-N 推薦必須用不同方式，也就是留一交叉驗證測試。

cues.en: Here, we're setting up Leave One Out with just a single train/test split, again in the interest of time.
cues.zh: 這裡同樣為了節省時間，將留一法設定為只有一次訓練／測試分割。

cues.en: What this does is set aside one rating per user, selected at random, for the test set.
cues.zh: 它會對每位使用者隨機挑選一筆評分，保留給測試集。

cues.en: Our challenge is to predict top-N recommendations that include the left-out movie.
cues.zh: 我們的挑戰，是預測出包含那部被留下電影的 Top-N 推薦。

cues.en: Since Leave One Out works on a per user basis, the way the train and test data sets are created is different, and we have to perform that split again.
cues.zh: 由於留一法以每位使用者為單位，訓練集與測試集的建立方式不同，所以必須重新分割。

cues.en: We iterate through each train/test split from our Cross Validator, which in our case will only be a single split.
cues.zh: 走訪交叉驗證器產生的每組訓練／測試分割，在這個例子裡只有一組。

cues.en: We then train our SVD algorithm all over again with our new training set, and test it again with our test set of left-out ratings for each user.
cues.zh: 接著，使用新的訓練集重新訓練 SVD，再以每位使用者被留下的評分所組成的測試集測試。

cues.en: Now the other thing we need is the actual complete list of top-N recommendations for each user that we want to evaluate.
cues.zh: 另外，還需要每位待評估使用者實際完整的 Top-N 推薦清單。

cues.en: To do that, we need to get rating predictions for every movie each user has not already rated, and then rank them by predicted rating.
cues.zh: 為此，要對每位使用者尚未評分的每部電影，取得評分預測，再按預測評分排序。

cues.en: By the way, you might remember that this is one of two possible architectures for a top-N recommender system, and it's not the more efficient of the two.
cues.zh: 順帶一提，你可能記得，這是 Top-N 推薦系統的兩種可能架構之一，而且不是比較有效率的那一種。

cues.en: Don't worry, we'll do it the other way as well in a bit.
cues.zh: 別擔心，稍後也會用另一種方式。

cues.en: But the thing that's a little tricky to wrap your head around is that we need what's called an Anti-Test set to create our top-N list for each user.
cues.zh: 不過，比較難理解的是，為了建立每位使用者的 Top-N 清單，需要所謂的反測試集，也就是 Anti-Test Set。

cues.en: That is, we only want to consider ratings from movies that users haven't already seen.
cues.zh: 也就是說，只考慮使用者尚未看過的電影評分。

cues.en: So we build up our test set for all possible user/movie pairs that are not in the training set, and restrict ourselves to those.
cues.zh: 因此，為所有不在訓練集中的使用者／電影配對，建立測試集，並只處理這些配對。

cues.en: Once we have that set of predictions, we can call the Get Top-N function we wrote earlier to produce top-N lists for each user, and now we can just go to town evaluating them.
cues.zh: 取得這組預測後，就能呼叫前面寫的 GetTopN 函數，為每位使用者產生 Top-N 清單，然後盡情評估。

cues.en: We'll do it all here; hit rate, then rating hit rate, then cumulative hit rate, and then average reciprocal hit rate, and print out the results.
cues.zh: 這裡全部都會算：命中率、評分命中率、累積命中率，再到平均倒數命中率，並印出結果。

cues.en: Next, we want to measure coverage, diversity and novelty.
cues.zh: 接著，衡量覆蓋率、多樣性與新穎性。

cues.en: These are all properties of the top-N recommendations as a whole, and don't involve measuring accuracy between a train set and a test set.
cues.zh: 它們是整體 Top-N 推薦的特性，不涉及衡量訓練集與測試集之間的準確程度。

cues.en: So to get the values we want, we need to train our model yet again, this time using the entirety of the set and not holding anything back for testing.
cues.zh: 因此，要取得需要的值，得再次訓練模型，這次使用完整資料集，不保留任何資料供測試。

cues.en: But again, we want to exclude recommendations from movies the users have already watched.
cues.zh: 但同樣地，要排除使用者已經看過的電影推薦。

cues.en: So we actually use an Anti-Test set on the full training set here to use for figuring out the top-N for each user.
cues.zh: 所以這裡會對完整訓練集使用反測試集，計算每位使用者的 Top-N 推薦。

cues.en: Once we have that, we can compute coverage, diversity and novelty as we discussed before.
cues.zh: 取得之後，就能按照前面討論的方式，計算覆蓋率、多樣性與新穎性。

cues.en: So now that we understand what this code does, let's kick it off and see what happens.
cues.zh: 既然了解這段程式碼的功能，就執行看看會發生什麼事。
